topic: Someone finds a time capsule they don't remember burying
text: The ground beneath my feet felt peculiarly soft, almost as if the earth itself was an ancient, well-worn sofa. It was then that I stumbled upon a metal box, wedged deep between the roots of what could only be described as a rather jovial tree, its branches swaying as if in greeting. The box, cool to the touch, seemed oddly misplaced, a relic in this familiar yet estranged landscape. I hesitated, the air thick with an unnameable anticipation, before lifting the lid. Inside, memories lay entwined with objects I couldn’t quite recall placing there myself. A childhood toy, a letter penned in a hand that felt both foreign and intimate, and a photograph of a face I knew yet couldn’t place. The contents whispered of a past I thought I knew, now threaded with mysteries of its own.
